title: PR stacked-PR nudge: native-stack advice lives in the Stack Nudge workflow (stack-nudge.yml), not advice.js
answers: Where is the bot comment recommending GitHub native stacks generated?
Why did the stacked PR advice stop appearing in advice.js output?
Which PR authors and descriptions trigger the stacked-PR nudge?
I want to add a new PR-description advice rule; which file should it go in?
body:
Path: PR open/edit automation that comments on pull requests. The `Stack Nudge` workflow (.github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml, job `nudge`) runs on `pull_request_target` `opened`/`edited` and posts the native-stacks recommendation when the PR body contains `🥞 Stacked PR`. The older stacked-PR check that lived in .github/workflows/advice.js was removed; advice.js keeps the other body/media/file advice.
Rule: Stacked-PR advice is owned by stack-nudge.yml. Its job `if:` gates on: author not a Bot, `author_association` in MEMBER/OWNER/COLLABORATOR, body contains `🥞 Stacked PR`, and the PR is not already a native stack (`!github.event.pull_request.stack`). Do not re-add the stacked-PR check to advice.js; put new workflow-specific PR-body nudges in their own workflow file with the same gating style.
Constraints: The workflow does not check out the repository; it uses inline shell and `gh` with `GH_TOKEN` and `permissions: pull-requests: write`. It only reacts to the PR body text at open/edit time, not to commits or existing comments. Does not apply to advice.js items that remain (media, UI file checks).
applies: Any request about the stacked-PR / GitHub stacks comment on pull requests or the PR-advice bot workflows.
says: The automated comment suggesting native GitHub stacks stopped appearing on pull requests.
Why is the stacked pull request recommendation bot not commenting on external contributor submissions?
Pull requests marked as stacked should receive advice promoting native stack features.
Stop posting stacked pull request hints on pull requests that already use native stacks.
Automated stack guidance comments should trigger whenever pull request descriptions are updated.

The nudge job runs on pull_request_target opened and edited events, gating on non-bot authors, author_association of MEMBER, OWNER, or COLLABORATOR, a body containing 🥞 Stacked PR, and !github.event.pull_request.stack. The workflow does not check out the repository, using inline shell with gh, GH_TOKEN, and pull-requests: write permissions, evaluating only PR body text without checking commits or comments. Stacked-PR checks must not be re-added to advice.js, which retains media and UI file checks.
